limitations: Not an exhaustive 2026 Finland-versus-Sweden checklist reconciliation.
GBIF absence is not proof of national absence; old checklist names and taxonomic splits need specialist review.
Recent Finnish counts do not prove expansion, arrival in Sweden or suitability.
Nocturna new-to-monitoring records must not be labelled first Finnish records.
Point licensing is independent of biological screening. No observations, taxa or high-interest flags are accepted automatically.
